messages:
emily: Heads up 1 AcmeNimbus POC asking for a temporary hosted API per-token override for embeddings. They estimate ~180M tokens over 28 days. Can we do a short-term unit price change?
omar: Are they committing post-POC? What is potential ARR?
emily: If converted, projected $420k ARR. No commit today. Primary ask: lower per-1k unit to validate cost/perf.
anna: What's the exact ask? One-off credit, per-token temporary rate, or min monthly?
emily: Sales proposal: 0.0025 / 1k tokens for embeddings during POC, cap at 250M tokens, and a $2,500 minimum invoice for the POC month.
omar: Need math: 180M tokens => 180,000 * 0.0025 = $450. So min charge covers infra.
anna: Finance needs to sign off on min and exception. Also legal needs to review if terms change.
deal-desk-bot: @emily Please file pricing exception: https://redwood.internal/deal-desk/new. Approvals required: Sales Lead, Finance. If T&Cs change, Legal.
security: Security check: SSO? Data retention? Any special compliance needs?
emily: SAML SSO confirmed, retention 30 days, no residency requirement.
billing: Billing note: We need an account ID and whether billing should auto-fallback to standard pricing after cap.
emily: Account ID: acm-nimbus-77. Yes, auto-fallback to standard rate after cap.
anna: I'll draft the exception. Include POC dates and model variant. Which model?
emily: Using rwm-mid-emb-v1 (hosted).
anna: Draft: 
```
POC Pricing Exception
Account: AcmeNimbus
Dates: 2026-05-05 -> 2026-06-02
Model: rwm-mid-emb-v1
Override rate: 0.0025 / 1k tokens for embeddings
Cap: 250M tokens
Min invoice: $2,500 in POC month
Conditions: LOI or MSA signed within 45 days of POC end; auto-fallback to list pricing after cap; no changes to TOS
Approvals: Sales Lead, Finance
```

omar: Fine, finance if you approve we'll move to billing config.
finance: Approved provided LOI or MSA is attached. Need probability to close and expected timeline.
deal-desk-bot: Request filed (DD-2026-122). Pending finance sign-off & billing config.
emily: Thanks all. Will attach LOI and usage profile shortly. We'll monitor usage daily.
anna: Billing / Ops: add alert at 80% of token cap.
billing: Will implement cap + fallback and alert. Will invoice min upfront.
emily: Launching POC tomorrow. Will send daily snapshots.
deal-desk-bot: Pricing exception active pending billing config. Notifying billing & ops.
